keyLimits.en: 20+ Adobe desktop and web apps (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, InDesign, Acrobat Pro), plus Firefly generative AI credits. Annual commitment billed monthly.
Per-license pricing (HT/excl. tax) for teams, includes license management and admin console.
Adds Adobe Stock access on top of the standard Pro teams plan.
First-year discounted price, then renews at 40.32€/month. Requires eligibility verification.

addOns.en: Adobe Firefly generative AI credit packs available separately from the base suite subscription.

cautions.en: Individual and teams plans require an annual commitment even though billed monthly; cancelling early during the commitment period incurs an early termination fee.
US pricing page shows a different promotional structure (e.g. $34.99/mo for 3 months then $69.99/mo) than the French page's flat 78.65€/mo, confirming prices and promotions vary by region.

capabilities.en: Bundles over 20 creative desktop and web apps (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, InDesign, Acrobat Pro, and more) under one subscription.
Includes Adobe Firefly generative AI features integrated across apps, with a monthly generative credit allowance.
Cloud storage, shared libraries, and centralized license management for teams via the admin console.

limitations.en: No permanent free plan for the full suite; only a 7-day trial for individuals.
Bundle pricing is significantly more expensive than buying a single app plan if only one application is needed.

unknowns: Whether the 14-day cancellation refund mentioned on the US page also applies to the French/EU plans was not verified.
Exact Firefly credit allowance included by default in the Pro individual plan was not itemized on the fetched pages.
conflicts: The French pricing page (78.65€/mo, TTC, individual Pro) and the US pricing page (promotional $34.99/mo then $69.99/mo) show materially different price structures for the same plan name, reflecting regional pricing rather than a data error.
